location.site_context: Lake Mariner Data Campus on the former Somerset coal plant site

actions.result_status: Fluidstack exercised CB-5 option; TeraWulf announced a new purpose-built CB-5 building adding 160 MW of critical IT load at Lake Mariner, with operations then expected in 2H 2026.

TeraWulf 10-K reported Akela Fluidstack leases for 378 MW of critical IT load at Lake Mariner, developed in multiple phases, with construction commenced in 2025 and delivery expected to commence in 2026.

County minutes state TeraWulf and subsidiaries are constructing the Lake Mariner Data Center in the Town of Somerset, Niagara County; county authorized outside counsel for sales-tax and road-use investigations.
TeraWulf Q2 2026 filing reported continued construction of 336 MW across CB-4 and CB-5; CB-5 targeted to begin phased delivery in early 2027.

owner: TeraWulf Inc. / Akela Data LLC; leased to Fluidstack USA I Inc.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.resolution: Corrected from baseline/current seed. County minutes identify Town of Somerset, Niagara County; TeraWulf site page identifies Barker, NY.

CB-5-specific TeraWulf announcement gives 160 MW. Later company filings provide aggregate Lake Mariner/Akela figures and Q2 2026 reports 336 MW across CB-4 and CB-5 without disaggregating CB-5, so the CB-5-specific value is retained.
